mapper.select: SELECT r.release_id, r.release_no, r.master_version_id, v.version_no AS master_version_no, r.master_name, r.master_display_alias, r.dependency_digest, r.published_at, (a.current_release_id = r.release_id) AS current FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_release r JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent a ON a.agent_id = r.master_agent_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version v ON v.agent_version_id = r.master_version_id WHERE r.master_agent_id = #{masterAgentId} ORDER BY r.release_no DESC

SELECT rt.tool_id, t.tool_code, rt.tool_name, rt.tool_display_alias AS display_alias, tv.tool_type, t.status AS tool_status, rt.tool_version_id, tv.version_no, tv.readiness, tv.exposed_name, tv.description, tv.read_only, rt.mcp_server_id, rt.mcp_server_version_id, rt.mcp_server_name, TRUE AS usable FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_release_tool rt JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool t ON t.tool_id = rt.tool_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool_version tv ON tv.tool_version_id = rt.tool_version_id WHERE rt.release_id = #{releaseId} AND rt.owner_agent_id = #{ownerAgentId} ORDER BY rt.sort_no ASC, rt.id ASC

SELECT rs.subagent_id, sub.agent_code AS subagent_code, rs.subagent_name, rs.display_alias AS subagent_display_alias, sub.agent_type AS subagent_type, sub.status AS subagent_status, rs.subagent_version_id, sv.version_no, sv.readiness, rs.delegation_name, rs.delegation_description, rs.display_alias, sv.description AS subagent_description, ( SELECT count(*) FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_release_tool rt WHERE rt.release_id = rs.release_id AND rt.owner_agent_id = rs.subagent_id ) AS tool_count, TRUE AS usable FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_release_subagent rs JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent sub ON sub.agent_id = rs.subagent_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version sv ON sv.agent_version_id = rs.subagent_version_id WHERE rs.release_id = #{releaseId} ORDER BY rs.sort_no ASC, rs.id ASC
